# OpenVR hand skeleton simulation

`hand_simulation.h/.cpp` and `vrmath.h` are unmodified copies of the OpenVR SDK sample
`samples/drivers/drivers/handskeletonsimulation` (and `samples/drivers/utils/vrmath`) at tag
`v2.15.6`, under the OpenVR SDK's BSD 3-Clause license (see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`).
They build the 31-bone SteamVR hand skeleton from per-finger curl and splay values.
